name: rtk
description: Install rtk, a CLI proxy that compresses bash command output to reduce LLM token consumption, with optional automatic hook setup for Claude Code and Codex.

version.description: Enter an rtk version (e.g. 'v0.44.1'), or use 'latest'.

claudeCodeHook.description: On container start, run 'rtk init -g --auto-patch' to automatically set up a Claude Code PreToolUse hook and RTK.md. Requires the claude-code feature.

codexHook.description: On container start, run 'rtk init -g --codex --auto-patch' to automatically set up Codex AGENTS.md/RTK.md integration. Requires the codex feature.
